highlights: Positive pressure systems across campus for clean air
Mandatory staff background and police checks
Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL) and active Safeguarding Team
Visitor lanyard and access control protocol
safety.policy_summary: Lanna International School maintains a comprehensive Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy informed by international guidelines and Thai legislation, ensuring strict staff vetting, background checks, regular mandatory training, and protocols for visitor identification and campus safety.
